main.title: Our Simple Two-Part Process
main.alt: Arrowhead painters working on the second-story gables of a Kansas City home

phases.name: The Estimate
steps: Call or request an estimate online.
We call to set a time that works for you.
We walk your home together and listen to your goals.
A clear, itemized proposal with no surprises.

phases.name: Your Project
steps: Scheduling and weather updates, start to finish.
Protected, prepped, and painted with premium materials.
We review it together, and your written warranty is sent with your invoice online.

main.videoAlt: Cade walking a home with a homeowner during an on-site estimate

exterior.title: Our Proven Exterior Painting Process
exterior.alt: Arrowhead crew on ladders painting a three-story home

phases.name: Before We Start
steps: We check paint, caulk, and wood on every side.
Colors that suit your roof, brick, and street.
We confirm the plan, schedule, and repairs.

phases.name: On The Job
steps: Plants and surfaces covered, then a full wash.
Rotted wood replaced, gaps caulked, loose paint removed.
Premium coatings, down to the last piece of trim.
Touch-ups done, and your written warranty arrives online with your invoice.

interior.title: Our Proven Interior Painting Process
interior.alt: Arrowhead crew cutting in a dining room with floors protected

phases.name: Before We Start
steps: We walk each room and talk through your goals.
Colors and sheens that work together.

phases.name: On The Job
steps: Nail pops, cracks, and dings smoothed out.
Ceilings, walls, and trim with clean lines.
Touch-ups done, and your written warranty arrives online with your invoice.

woodrot.title: Our Proven Wood Rot Repair & Carpentry Process
woodrot.alt: New siding panels installed across two stories during a repair

phases.name: Find It
steps: We probe trim and siding and show you every soft spot.

phases.name: Fix It
steps: Cut back to solid wood. Hidden damage? We show you first.
Cedar, LP SmartSide, James Hardie, AZEK, or PVC.
Flashed, caulked, and painted to match.

steps: We learn how your business operates.

phases.name: Painting
